subject: [PATCH v6 02/19] selftests/mm: skip collapse_compound_extreme() where the PMD is too large

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm/khugepaged test to skip a specific case where the PMD (Page Map Directory) size is too large, causing the allocator to fail reliably. The test in question, collapse_compound_extreme(), requires multiple consecutive allocations of a certain size, which becomes unreliable when the PMD size exceeds 32M. By skipping this case, the patch ensures that the test does not fail abruptly and allows other cases to run successfully.
